---
title: Tìm kiếm
format: html
page-layout: full
---

:::{.search-container}

<input type="text" id="searchInput" placeholder="Nhập từ khóa..." style="width: 100%; padding: 10px; font-size: 1.2em; margin-bottom: 20px;" />

<div id="results"></div>

:::

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fuse.js@6.6.2"></script>
<script>
  // Tải dữ liệu từ search-index.json
  fetch("search-index.json")
    .then(response => response.json())
    .then(data => {
      const fuse = new Fuse(data, {
        keys: ["title", "description", "tags"],
        threshold: 0.3,
        includeScore: true
      });

      const input = document.getElementById("searchInput");
      const resultsDiv = document.getElementById("results");

      input.addEventListener("input", function () {
        const query = input.value.trim();
        if (query.length === 0) {
          resultsDiv.innerHTML = "";
          return;
        }

        const results = fuse.search(query);
        resultsDiv.innerHTML = results.map(result => {
          const item = result.item;
          return `
            <div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">
              <a href="${item.path}" style="font-size: 1.2em; font-weight: bold;">${item.title}</a><br>
              <span style="color: #666;">${item.description}</span><br>
              <small>Tags: ${item.tags.join(", ")}</small>
            </div>
          `;
        }).join("");
      });
    });
</script>
